# fög Abstimmungsmonitor — V10.2 interim pilot

Reviewed printed cover dates and figure 1 on PDF page 2 of the seven original interim reports in 2021–22. Only the contemporaneous highlighted rows were transcribed (not historical comparison bars, whose numbers may be revised). 24 objects mapped to existing Swissvotes keys and dates. AHV reform combines two legal objects, so both receive identical aggregate tone and volume, counted once for relative prominence. The March 2021 window is 8 weeks; all others 9 weeks, according to figure captions. Date-level volume is not a count of unique articles across topics. Source dates are printed dates, not independently archived edition timestamps. Source URL, page, figure and labels are retained; reviewed CSV hash will be in result manifest. PDF byte hashes not yet captured. Source archive: https://www.foeg.uzh.ch/de/research/1-Aktuelle-Projekte/abstimmungsmonitor.html . Older interim reports listed 2016–20 remain to be acquired; no post-vote final reports or historical comparison bars used. No temporal change feature because only one verified snapshot per date so far.

Prespecified pilot: frozen V8.1 reference; historical residual bias-only control; tone; tone + log volume per week; tone + date-relative prominence. Ridge penalty 8, correction clipped to +/-10 pp, minimum six earlier covered objects and two distinct prior dates. All parameters fixed before scores. Missing media and insufficient history fall back to V8.1. Current-date ballots used only for scoring and later-date residuals. The model estimates historical aggregate outcomes only. No deployment.
